children: Third Acquisition in Less Than 12 Months, Continuing Accelerated Growth Strategy
CENTENNIAL, Colo, Sept. 08, 2026

-- Family Office of America (OTC: [FOFA]) ("FOFA" or the "Company") today announced that its subsidiary, Family Office of Maryland, LLC, has entered into an agreement to acquire certain assets of J F Kearney & Associates, P.A., a Maryland-based accounting and tax services practice led by James F. Kearney.

The transaction represents the Company's third acquisition in less than 12 months and marks another significant step in FOFA's strategy of building a diversified professional and financial services platform through strategic acquisitions and organic growth.

J F Kearney & Associates has established a strong reputation for providing accounting and tax-related services to businesses and individuals and has developed longstanding client relationships. Following the transaction, the practice will operate as the JF Kearney Division of Family Office of Maryland, with James Kearney continuing to lead the Division and remain actively involved in serving clients and managing operations.

FOFA believes the combination creates an opportunity to preserve the personalized service and client relationships that have contributed to the practice's success while providing access to the broader resources, technology, personnel and capabilities of the Family Office platform.

The transaction also creates opportunities to expand the services available to clients, including bookkeeping, financial planning, estate planning, tax planning and wealth management, through appropriately qualified professionals and providers.
Rico Conte, Co-Founder and Director of M&A of Family Office of America, said:

"We are extremely excited to welcome James Kearney and his clients to Family Office of America. James has built a highly respected practice with strong, longstanding client relationships, and we believe our platform can provide the additional resources and capabilities necessary to take the business to its next level. Just as importantly, James will continue to be directly involved in the business and serving his clients."
Conte continued,

"This acquisition is particularly meaningful because it is our third transaction in less than 12 months. We believe this demonstrates that our M&A strategy is gaining significant momentum. We continue to have a robust pipeline of acquisition opportunities and are actively pursuing businesses that fit our strategic objectives, have strong client relationships and can benefit from becoming part of a larger platform."
Patrick Adams, Co-Founder and CEO of Family Office of America, said:

"The Kearney acquisition is another important milestone in executing our vision for Family Office of America. We are bringing together established businesses, experienced professionals and complementary services to create a broader platform capable of delivering greater value to clients while creating opportunities for long-term growth. The fact that we have completed three acquisitions in less than 12 months is a strong reflection of the team's ability to execute that vision."

FOFA intends to continue evaluating additional acquisition opportunities as it expands its professional services platform and seeks to build a larger, diversified organization through disciplined M&A and organic growth.
About Family Office of America

Family Office of America is building a diversified professional-services and financial-services platform through organic growth and strategic acquisitions. The Company's strategy is focused on acquiring established businesses with strong client relationships and experienced management teams, while providing additional resources and capabilities to support long-term growth.
